Vendored third-party JavaScript used by the Atlas graph views (Knowledge graph,
Transformations DAG, Unified lineage). Fetched from the public npm registry and
committed as static files served by nginx alongside the rest of ui/ — no
runtime CDN fetches, matching the app's existing self-contained deployment
model (see ui/Dockerfile). Load order matters: dagre.min.js and
cytoscape.min.js must load before cytoscape-dagre.js and
cytoscape-node-html-label.min.js (both are Cytoscape plugins).

cytoscape.min.js
  Package:  cytoscape
  Version:  3.30.4
  License:  MIT
  Source:   https://www.npmjs.com/package/cytoscape
  Purpose:  Graph rendering engine core (pan/zoom/drag, edge routing,
            selection, events). No network calls, no telemetry.

dagre.min.js
  Package:  dagre
  Version:  0.8.5
  License:  MIT
  Source:   https://www.npmjs.com/package/dagre
  Purpose:  Directed-graph layered layout algorithm (used by
            cytoscape-dagre) — produces the left-to-right hierarchical
            layout for the dbt DAG, knowledge graph neighborhoods, and
            unified lineage.

cytoscape-dagre.js
  Package:  cytoscape-dagre
  Version:  2.5.0
  License:  MIT
  Source:   https://www.npmjs.com/package/cytoscape-dagre
  Purpose:  Cytoscape layout adapter for dagre. Shipped unminified
            (12.7 KB) — the package does not publish a minified build.

cytoscape-node-html-label.min.js
  Package:  cytoscape-node-html-label
  Version:  1.2.2
  License:  MIT
  Source:   https://www.npmjs.com/package/cytoscape-node-html-label
  Purpose:  Renders rich HTML node cards (columns/sensitive counts,
            badges, expand controls) positioned by Cytoscape's layout,
            instead of Cytoscape's native canvas-only labels.

To upgrade any of these: download the new version's browser build(s) from
the packages above, review the diff, and replace the matching file here.
Unminified sources are not included (to keep the deployed image small);
consult each npm package for source maps if debugging is needed.
